form_inputs.do_not_regress_rules:
M27 remains immutable design-only Auxiliar/Assistant input/output contract design and must not implement live input processing, live output generation, or live contract validation.
M27 must not start Assistant, Auxiliar, Pilot, or Copilot behavior.
M27 must not activate shadow mode, compare routes, select routes, load prompts, integrate runtime routing, or grant router authority.
M27 must not read/write files, persist evidence, write reports, write review queues, record human decisions, mutate gold sets, mutate registries, call providers, use embeddings, promote candidates, or execute patches.
Future outputs remain non-authoritative human-review support only and must carry no routing effect, prompt-loading effect, persistence effect, or Assistant activation effect.
M28 requires separate governed Auxiliar/Assistant contract validator design and does not imply Assistant activation.
Project-specific frozen memory must remain under project_freeze_after_update/frozen_features_memory.
Do not store project-specific frozen memory inside project_freeze_ledger.
After a local freeze write, the AI startup freeze context must be refreshed.
Preview Freeze Entry must remain read-only and must not write files.
Confirm and Write must require explicit human confirmation before writing governed freeze memory.
External AI review remains advanced/fallback, not the normal local freeze path.
